did: Home's web app and the résumé service now come from server's release, pinned by digest, so make home-deploy moves them and nothing is pulled from a some-ui checkout by hand. The owner switches over once on the box: stop some-ui's old stack, clear the remembered failed deploys, then make home-deploy. On the way, the new chrono advisories that turned every server PR red were ignored with a tracking issue, and envctl's help now names its real state folder.

calls.title: www and resume-render are pinned but held, not followed, until their images carry the release labels (C740)
options: left out of the release until labelled
calls.why: The release only follows a some-ui image once the set check can read what it needs, and neither published image wrote its labels yet.
calls.undo: Move both from HELD to SOURCES in release_lock.py, together, once the labelled images are published.

calls.title: www and resume-render are interactive class, and www runs read-only with only the four capabilities nginx needs (C742)
options: www writable, as some-ui ran it
calls.why: Someone waits on every page and every résumé render, and nginx was measured to start with nothing more than those four capabilities.
calls.undo: Change oom_score_adj and the capabilities in infra/compose/www.yml, and the class table in docs/home-compute.md.

calls.title: The only label edge between them is resume-api; www states no requirement on file_host's contract (C743)
calls.why: Clients already check file_host's contract at run time through compat, so a release-time edge would duplicate it.
calls.undo: Add contract to www's requires label, passed in from the route snapshot at build.

calls.title: On home the web container is named www, not some-ui-www (C744)
calls.why: It is a server service now, named like the others.
calls.undo: Rename container_name in infra/compose/www.yml and its inventory entry.

left: Following www and resume-render automatically waits on some-ui#3275 and the next www release, then one small server PR.
Moving off chrono is its own story, server#1018.
The rollback still does not stop services a failed release added, server#861.
